newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian cities' CPI data due out next week.
newsitem.headline: Italian cities' CPI data due out next week.

text.p: The Italian city of Milan will publish its preliminary May consumer price inflation data at 1530 GMT on Wednesday, May 21, while Bologna will release its figures at the same time on Thursday, May 22, the cities said.
Milan and Bologna are two of the 11 cities due to publish CPI data next week. National statistics body Istat has not yet detailed which of the two days the others will be publishing.
In April, Italian inflation posted a 0.1 percent month-on-month rise for a yearly figure of 1.7 percent, the lowest rate for 28 years. Final May national data will be released on June 4.
